verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI and MCP server can manage rows, files and users, and the CLI runs headless for automation, so an agent could script operations over many items. None of the evidence documents a native bulk create, update or delete capability, so this only glancingly supports the story. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch APIs for rows/files/users, bulk operations exposed via the MCP server or CLI, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
